places.name: Queens Park
places.ai_summary: A sprawling park in the heart of Invercargill, featuring gardens, walking trails, and a golf course.

opening_hours.notes: Accessible year-round.

places.place_tip: Visit the aviary and rose garden for a relaxing experience.

places.name: Bluff Hill Lookout
places.ai_summary: A scenic viewpoint offering panoramic views of the Southland coastline and Stewart Island.

opening_hours.notes: Best visited during daylight hours.

places.place_tip: Bring a camera to capture the stunning views.

places.name: Stewart Island
places.ai_summary: A pristine island known for its wildlife, hiking trails, and the Rakiura National Park.

opening_hours.notes: Accessible year-round.

places.place_tip: Take a guided tour to spot kiwi birds in their natural habitat.

places.name: Fiordland National Park
places.ai_summary: A UNESCO World Heritage site, known for its stunning fiords, waterfalls, and rainforests.

opening_hours.notes: Best visited during the day for sightseeing.

places.place_tip: Take a boat tour to explore the fiords up close.
places.address: Fiordland National Park, Southland, New Zealand

places.ai_summary: A famous fiord in Fiordland National Park, known for its stunning scenery and wildlife.

opening_hours.notes: Best visited during the day for sightseeing.

places.place_tip: Consider an overnight cruise for a unique experience.
places.address: Milford Sound, Fiordland National Park, Southland, New Zealand

places.place_tip: Bring binoculars for wildlife spotting.
places.address: Doubtful Sound, Fiordland National Park, Southland, New Zealand

places.name: Kepler Track (Great Walk)
places.ai_summary: A popular multi-day hike in Fiordland, known for its stunning scenery and diverse landscapes.

opening_hours.notes: Best walked from late October to April.

places.address: Kepler Track, Fiordland National Park, Southland, New Zealand

places.place_tip: Don't miss the vintage car collection and interactive exhibits.

places.name_english: Ulva Island / Te Wharawhara Marine Reserve

opening_hours.notes: Best visited during the day for birdwatching.

places.place_tip: Take a guided walk to learn about the local ecology.
